posts.author: d paul
posts.content_md:
Hello there

I would like to take some time now to indtroduce my self and what i've been doing. All this started from a used book on antique color photo-graphy I picked up. In it was a description of Lippmann photography with a picture that really made me want to do this myself. 

 so after a year of trying to make my own plates(with a lot of help from Darren Green) I decided to see if they would also work for holography.

 --and they do!

 I am using a 20-40mw 670nm diode laser which seems ok,but probally could use some temp control, and am playing around with a cheap 50mw 532 dpss laser which does make a holo but not a good one .

 I am waiting to try out mbdcg.
